symptoms: Acute diarrhoea without blood in adults

management_steps.details: 4 mg immediately and 2 mg as required after each loose stool. Maximum daily dose based on weight band: 34-39 kg: 10 mg (5 tablets); 40-46 kg: 12 mg (6 tablets); 47-53 kg: 14 mg (7 tablets); >= 54 kg: 16 mg (8 tablets).
Do not use in children or acute dysentery.

record.notes_updates: Do not use in children or acute dysentery.
